chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about the leftover water of the Jew and the Christian, and he said: “No.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbd Allāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سُؤْرِ: leftover liquid or remains in a vessel after someone has drunk from it
key_terms.لَا: no; a negative ruling or response

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about the leftover water of a Jew or a Christian?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding the leftover water touched or drunk from by a Jew or a Christian. The Imam’s brief reply indicates a negative ruling in this context, making the narration relevant to discussions of ritual purity in fiqh.
